svg.title: Time per aggregate question on 1,000,000 orders
svg.desc: Median warm latency of seven aggregate questions on PostgreSQL, pg_sift, Elasticsearch, ClickHouse, Citus columnar and pg_duckdb.
svg.text: 7 aggregate questions on 1,000,000 orders: time per question
Median of the warm runs in milliseconds on a logarithmic axis, left is faster; the line of a dot runs from the fastest to the
slowest run. Every question is answered by every system.

svg.text: Data: docs/results/store.json, duckdb.tsv, 2026-10-22, AMD Ryzen 7 9700X, 16 threads, 8g per server, 3 CPUs.
PostgreSQL 18.6, pg_sift 3.3, Elasticsearch 9.5.5, ClickHouse 26.9.19.9, Citus 14.2-1, pg_duckdb 1.1.1. One client, the same rows in every
system; Elasticsearch with its request cache off; pg_duckdb is its own run (the better of heap and Parquet, a different PostgreSQL build).
